ambient_events: The mirror flank slides your reflection past, stretched and improved.
A cyan band ticks a shade brighter as the light goes.
A car with tinted glass idles at the plinth, waits, and is gone.
The crown beacon pulses once, high enough that you lose it in the haze.
description: Chrome Court goes up out of the Marquee like something dropped rather than built: a smooth tapered obelisk of mirror steel, decagonal, seamless, throwing the whole cheap pink-and-cyan street back at itself in a warped and flattering curve. Cyan LED bands ring it at every tech-floor, a brighter halo marks the sky-lounge two thirds up, and a beacon pulses off the spire at the crown. At street level the mirror splays into a lit plinth and a doorway that does not so much open as decide. Nothing here has been repainted, because nothing here has ever been allowed to weather.
name: Chrome Court
